settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A dinosaur skeleton of T-Rex and Rhinoceros, modelled bone by bone - skull, ribs, spine, limbs and claws - for assembly into a striking display. A showstopping centrepiece for museums, exhibitions, schools and bold interiors, built to the size you need. Both dinosaur skeletons are about 1.7 metres long - the height of an average adult.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your species, size, finish and mounting
settings.s1_body: We 3D-print dinosaur skeletons part by part - every vertebra, rib, claw and the unmistakable skull - and finish them in a natural bone tone ready to assemble and display. Whether you want a tabletop skull, a wall-mounted section or a full standing skeleton, we scale the build to your space. A dramatic, conversation-starting centrepiece for museums, exhibitions, classrooms and adventurous interiors.
settings.case_heading: Built for the OliOli Children's Museum
settings.case_body: Produced for an educational event for children: the T-Rex and Rhinoceros bones were hidden under sand, and kids used shovels to dig out every bone. It made for a fun, hands-on activation at the museum.
settings.case_quote: Kids enjoyed the event and they loved the dinosaur skeleton.
settings.prov_p: Few objects spark curiosity like a dinosaur skeleton. 3D printing makes that museum-grade drama achievable and affordable, at whatever scale your space allows.
